user_saw: Possibly brief Gateway responsiveness hiccups (about 60 ms synchronous segments) while a very large managed workspace was reconciled; the fix itself does not reproduce the reported production stall.
summary: Prepares a transferable copy of the workspace rollback pack in the Git worker and sends it to the SQLite worker outside the structured-clone envelope, moving oversized-mutation diagnostics into the SQLite worker, so the Gateway thread no longer serializes ~120 MB packs.
reasoning: This is a performance optimization in a series (#194475, #196835) of reconciliation-stall reductions: the main-thread serialization of the rollback pack was the original design, not something a later commit made slower, and the PR's own benchmark shows 60 ms segments reduced to 8 ms without reproducing the reported 1.1 s production stall. Per the rubric, a performance improvement of code that was never faster is not-a-defect; no causing commit is identified.
